self_assessment.weakest_area: C3/C4 (no description / 0 installs) verified by code-reading the v-if guards rather than a real example, since github org has descriptions+installs on every skill. Other orgs may surface the empty-state branches.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Whether to keep the per-card 'npm' badge. Removed it because (a) for github/awesome-copilot the install path uses 'gh:' not 'npm:', and (b) the same badge on every card under a repo header is redundant chrome. Flagged in the contract as out of scope for the wider site (other pages still show it).

known_limitations: Other pages (/skills, homepage popular skills, /nuxt) still use the old install-cmd-prominent card pattern. This redesign is scoped to /orgs/[owner] only; rolling it out site-wide is a follow-up.
The 'npm' badge mislabel issue (gh:-installed skills shown as 'npm') exists on /skills, /skills/official, homepage popular skills. Not addressed in this job.
next_steps: Optional: roll the same description-first card pattern out to /skills grid view, /skills/official, and homepage popular skills — they share the install-cmd-in-card anti-pattern.
Optional: replace the 'npm' badge with a 'guide' / 'package' label that matches the actual install prefix (gh: vs npm:).
